title: 4/22 result polling keyed to the primary's 20:40 ET game: the scheduler planned to sleep until 20:50 through the live 14:10 ET double-down game
tier_reason: result polling was absent for 36-130 minutes of a live pick game before the same-hour fix deploy restarted it; final grading was intact via the 01:00 check-results backfill and the dashboard was unaffected; no residual

contract.text: Result polling starts 10 minutes after the first pitch of the earliest pick game (primary or double-down) and persists slot results while games are live.
contract.source: commit b681f8a message body; src/bts/scheduler.py run_day step 8 ('Result polling (start 10 min after game start, check for hits mid-game)')

mechanism.text: run_day computed poll_start as the primary pick's game_time + 10 min; when the double-down's game started earlier, the scheduler sat in time.sleep until the primary's start, so run_result_polling (which already tracked both game_pks) never ran during the double-down game

verified_recovered.how: c43869d body (16:30 ET) reports the scheduler already in result_polling for the same slate, which the primary-keyed code would have deferred to 20:50 ET

watchdog.trigger: while any pick game is Live, the scheduler heartbeat shows SLEEPING with sleeping_until later than that game's first pitch + 10 min, or a pick game has been Final for 30 min with no persisted slot result
watchdog.recovery_assertion: result polling runs during every pick game and each slot result is persisted before the 01:00 check-results backfill

evidence.what: observed live 2026-04-22: primary game at 20:40 ET, double-down game at 14:10 ET; the scheduler slept until 20:50, missing the double-down's live window; the dashboard was unaffected and the 01:00 cron backfills final results
the scheduler had entered result_polling for the same two-game slate before 16:30 ET
deploy-branch push of head b681f8a created 2026-04-22T18:55:57Z (14:55:57 ET), conclusion success; log unavailable_expired
until 4/28 deploys pulled origin/main; ev2 suggests this deploy did apply code

notes: tier: prelim A; drafted B because the actual gap was cut short by the 14:56 ET fix deploy (bounds in restored_verification) and only mid-game persistence was affected - flip to A if the lead counts any absence of polling during a live pick game as a liveness failure
onset = the double-down's 14:10 ET first pitch + 10 min, the start the contract requires
